_comment: Series catalog. polarity: +1 higher reads as stronger/better, -1 higher reads as weaker/riskier, 0 neutral (score measures how unusual the reading is, not direction). transform is what the score's level/z/percentile are computed on: level (the raw value), yoy_pct, mom_pct, or diff (change vs previous observation). Percent changes over 7/30/90/365 days are always reported on the raw value. cross_check groups series from different sources that should agree; a mismatch raises an alert and a risk flag. SEC and openFDA rows are expanded by lib/catalog.js from the templates at the bottom. Excluded on licensing grounds (third-party copyright on FRED): University of Michigan sentiment, LBMA gold, VIX, ICE BofA spreads.

sec._comment: One company facts pull and one submissions pull per company per day. skip_metrics lists concepts a company does not report (confirmed on the first live run, 2026-10-04: banks have no operating income or current assets/liabilities; XOM, PFE, LLY and JNJ do not tag OperatingIncomeLoss; JPM has no framed long-term debt and XOM none after 2017; batch 4, 2026-10-05: Amazon and Netflix pay no dividends, Disney pays twice a year so has no quarterly dividends, and banks report no capex); ratios built on a skipped metric are skipped too. Metrics come from XBRL frames (CYyyyyQn for quarters, CYyyyy for fiscal years, ...I for instants) so every value is the one SEC deduplicated across filings. concepts lists fallbacks in order.
